description: This Java source file defines the ModelGroupReader class, which handles reading and caching entity group configurations from XML resources within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages entity group mappings, resource handling, and provides methods to retrieve group information based on entity names and delegator configurations.

classes.name: ModelGroupReader
classes.description: Handles reading, caching, and providing access to entity group configurations from XML resources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModelGroupReader
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ModelGroupReader for a given delegator name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ModelGroupReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes resource handlers based on entity group configuration and component resources.

methods.name: getGroupCache
methods.description: Loads and caches entity-to-group mappings from XML resources, synchronized for thread safety.

methods.name: getEntityGroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name for a given entity, or the default if not explicitly mapped.

methods.name: getGroupNames
methods.description: Returns all group names defined in the entity group configuration for a delegator.

methods.name: getEntityNamesByGroup
methods.description: Returns all entity names associated with a specified group.
